he.text: לְמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ עָמְדוּ הַיּוֹם כִּי הַכֹּל עֲבָדֶיךָ ׃ וְהוּא יִשְׁפֹּט תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק · יָדִין לְאֻמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים ׃ מִלְּפָנֶיךָ מִשְׁפָּטֵנוּ יֵצֵא · עֵינֶיךָ תֶחֱזֶינָה מֵישָׁרִים ׃

en.text: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants. And he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with equity. Let our sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.
